steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Hey everyone! It's your old friend, Nancy!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: And your brand new friend, Click!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Huh? Hold up, Click! Stop messing around!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Ahem! After watching all those videos, I'm sure you know this 'abandoned factory' pretty well.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Legend has it that it used to be the nomadic plate of a Columbian pharmaceutical company, but was abandoned for some reason. The employees committed mass suicide, and even the boss mysteriously went missing in the middle of bustling Trimounts.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: But that's not all...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Though many brave adventurers have visited here, the story goes that most of them vanished, and the few who made it back have been hospitalized ever since, unable to say a word.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: At the same time, more people began subscribing to an alternative version of the legend—that the boss never went missing, but instead killed himself, and those who venture deep into the factory end up cursed!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: That's enough chit-chat though, I'm starting to get chills all over! It's not like I'm scared or anything, but—

steps.name: Click
steps.text: That's because we made it here to the abandoned factory! Take a look, everyone—less than fifty meters behind us is the entrance to the infamous, abandoned plate!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: We're gonna take you in to explore the truth behind this abandoned factory, and pull back the curtain on this paranormal phenomenon!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I'm your brand new friend, Click!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Cut! Perfect!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Lights! Lights! Robbie, how many times have I told you to keep a close eye on the lighting? You make me look good, and that nabs the audience's attention!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: I can't do it! Th-This place is way too scary!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: And Click, where'd you pop out from? Are you really a newbie coming along for your first shoot? I've never seen a fresh face as enthusiastic as you.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: That's how you spice up a video! You keep rattling off those bland, rehashed intros and I'll click off the page right away!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Alright, alright. I can cut you some slack since it's just the intro, but after we head in, I need you to stick to the script, alright? I've got everything here planned out very carefully. We can't have it going wrong.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Hey, no running around!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Remember, Robbie, you're gonna let out a piercing scream after you go through that door. Then, you fake a fall toward the rocks next to you and lead the camera over to transition to our next scene—

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Click, after you film him screaming, head down the hallway and we'll be good for the transition—You catch all that?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: 'Make sure we don't get stuck with a crappy view count. Not only is it humiliating, it's also a waste of money. Can't keep filming if you don't have money, and can't make money if you don't keep filming.' See, I memorized it!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Cap'n, how about moving this line up to the opener? It'll definitely make things spicier!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Urgh... I feel another headache coming on...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: But I have to say, that doesn't seem like a bad idea.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Testing, testing. We getting a signal in here? Can you hear me?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Gah! Don't scare me like that! Lemme turn the volume down first... Thought I was gonna go deaf.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Loud and clear. Let's start filming!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: ––Yo, guys! We're inside the abandoned factory now.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: We each have our own cameras, recording everything we see on our expedition to provide you the most authentic footage!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: I'll start heading down from the top of the building, while Click and Robbie go up from the first floor. We'll set off at the same time and explore from two different directions, then meet in the middle. Let's find out for ourselves what this curse is all about!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Alright, you guys get going too!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hmm, Robbie, there's something written here. Lemme see... 'Stay away, or you'll die.'

steps.name: Click
steps.text: 'The curse is real!' 'Save me!' 'Don't look back.'

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: S-S-Stop talking and start shooting! Let me focus here...
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hehe, can I draw something on the wall? Lemme add... myself doing a V-pose here! Peace, peace!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: 'Sup, everyone. The time now is 12:15 a.m. on July 13th, and we've just entered the first floor lobby of this abandoned factory.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: It sure is cold in here. I remember someone came in to film, and ended up going insane after they got back.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Shall we commemorate the occasion as well? Then, we can catalogue everything we see here. I'm sure the others are dying to know about it too. C'mon, I'll stand over here—

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: A bloated fowlbeast... Oh, some sort of taxidermy?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What is something like that doing here? Isn't this supposed to be an abandoned factory?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: This looks more like something you'd see in a hospital...

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Are we still filming...?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: L-Let's worry about that later...
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Okay then... By the way, do you hear that sound I keep hearing?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What sound? I'm too focused on the stench from this puddle of liquid.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Let's... keep recording, I guess?
The two continue down the barren hall, the strange scent prickling at their sinuses, creating an uncanny atmosphere.
It is as if they have been cut off from the outside world, completely engulfed and surrounded by something that should not exist.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: We've followed the strange noises down the corridor, and have now arrived at the deepest part of the first floor.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: There are rows of rooms to our sides that feel like they haven't seen visitors in years. Let's pick a door and see what's inside.

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Alright, I'll do it...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Whew...

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: The door opened on its own?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Were you the one knocking on the door just now?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: N-No, it wasn't me.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Well, it wasn't me either...

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: S-S-Stop trying to freak me out...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (*Gulps*) Let's head in and take a look?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: I, I think I'm good...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Wanna stay behind me then? Also, give the boss an update on how we're doing. We're almost done shooting up here. We should start heading upstairs.
Click tightly grips the video camera in her hands.
It's pitch-dark all around her and she can't see a thing. Only through the hazy green fog of the small night-vision screen on the side of the camera does she notice a small, discolored corridor.
Everything starts to feel surreal. She waits for an answer from her crewmate.
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie?
Click turns around, but there's nobody behind her.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: ...Robbie? Where'd you go?

No response. There is a loud sound of a heavy object falling to a ground, followed by a whimper like that of a wounded beast. From the darkness comes a faint sound of claws scratching against the ground.
*Loud rustling sounds*

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie? Where are you?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: ...Robbie, is that you?
Click runs past several empty rooms, one after another, the video camera's small night-vision screen already having become her eyes.
She can't control the wild thoughts prancing through her mind—
If... If there really was something lurking in the dark, would she be able to sense it? Would she be able to... get away from it?
Is there really... nobody behind her?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: I'm over here! Hurry–

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie! You scared me half to death! Didn't we talk about running off? Where'd you go, all of a sudden?!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... How'd you even run this far?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie? Where are you? I don't see you yet. It's too dark in here...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Ugh... And what's with all these ashes?!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Hurry and get over here! I found it––

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I still don't see you though!
Click raises the video camera again. For some reason, hardly any time passes before its battery runs out.
The red battery warning icon keeps flashing, its flickering casting figure-like shadows across the walls.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie, wave for me real quick?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer?
steps.text: I found it—

steps.name: Lighting Engineer?
steps.text: Found it—
Vague traces of light and shadow interplay in front of him, as if the cowardly man is forced to repeat the same lines over and over.
Click lets out a sigh of relief.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: How'd you get all the way over here? I thought you were too scared to go off alone!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Are you pretending to be scared? Is this just a bit for the video?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Well... It's solid acting, but you're not gonna spook me that easily, you know?
Robbie doesn't respond. Click reaches over to pat him on the shoulder.
She could've sworn it was Robbie.
Wait... is that really Robbie?
Bam!
Click's hand hits a hard object.
The wooden skeleton collapses to the ground, the rags on it fluttering in the wind when that voice rings out again—

steps.name: Lighting Engineer?
steps.text: I found it—I found it—

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Gaah!
Ka-chack!
The place where sound came from was nothing more than a mess of tangled wires. Two red signal lights flicker, pause, and then repetitive sounds come from beneath the debris.
'I'm over here! Hurry up! I found it—'
'I found it—I found it—'
'I found it—'

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie? Robbie! Why's my video camera completely out of juice already?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie? Captain? Oh right, the captain. I still have my comms terminal... Captain! Where are you? Robbie's gone missing!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Pick up... Please, pick up...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: ...Click... missing...? Rob... hurry up...!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Click... get out... dark...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Captain! Captain? What's wrong with this thing all of a sudden? Ugh...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What time is it...? Huh? How is it still 12:15?! I...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Why am I back on the first floor? Didn't I go upstairs? Hmm, maybe the second floor looks the same... Yeah, that's gotta be it...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Wait, this is me... doing a V pose...?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Does that mean... I'm on the first floor?
*Rustling sounds*
Suddenly, a noise comes from the video camera. Click looks down: on the screen swirling with snowflakes is Robbie's pale face, plastered with scarlet wounds.
His lifeless eyes look straight into the camera before he lets out a horrific scream—
Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh––––!!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Perfection! That's the ticket, Click! We've got all the footage we need. Our new video's gonna go viral for sure! Let's pack it up, everyone!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: I've already decided how I'm gonna edit this. So if you have any ideas, feel free to chime in. C'mon, c'mon, we're aiming for the top!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: ...Click?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (So scared... I don't wanna think about it anymore...)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Finally outta there... Soon I can head back to my room, curl up with my blanket, and enjoy some snacks...)

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: The door... The door opened on its own!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Were you the one knocking on the door just now?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: N-No, it wasn't me.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Well, it wasn't me either...
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (No! I need to get this out of my head...)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (I'm out. I'm already out. None of this is real...)
'I'm over here! Hurry up! I found it—'
'I found it—I found it—'
'I found it!'
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh––––!!)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (What was that noise the whole time?! Was someone else in there?)

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Click?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: *gasp*... *gasp*...!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Come in, Click. Are you reading me?! Hey, after I finish editing, I'll treat you guys to dinner!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Goddamned kurwa bloody ta ma de hell—!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: He was like this when I found him. He was going around punching trees, apparently chasing after something that scared him in the factory. There probably aren't a whole lot of leaves left in that patch of the woods.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: C'mere, Click. Let's trim the video together. Didn't you always say you wanted to scrounge up enough money to film your own videos? When we top the charts, I'll give you a bonus!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Oh... Sure.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (The captain seems so calm, but Robbie's scared out of his mind... Weren't we in the same place?)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Ugh... Do I work on the video first, or calm Robbie down? Or maybe, I need to calm myself down...)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hyah! Dammit, can't believe I'm getting spooked by my own video.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Any idea what happened to make Robbie like this? He still hasn't recovered.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Can't tell... But this scene is pretty terrifying, for sure. You can see the camera shaking and hear his panting, and you even get glimpses of his face every now and then.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Oh, I don't mean him, he's not what's scary.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: But, those wounds on his face definitely aren't something he could make by himself, and I kept hearing rustling sounds the whole time...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: One sec! Let's cut here to add a transition and some narration. Starting from the staircase, then—

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Mmhmm. Turn up the brightness, blur out all the garbage, and then amplify the breathing sounds...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: The door opening, the scream, the chase up the stairs. Cut here, then swap over to my perspective...
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Cap'n, do you hear that?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Yeah... What is it?
*Rustling sounds*

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: I heard the very same sound! It was when I was on the roof. I got your call, and then...
*Rustling sounds*
Though she's returned to the light of day, Click still feels like she's in that dark factory.
She leans closer to the monitor, to the constantly-shaking perspective, the chaotic background sounds, and Robbie's panicked panting. Click turns up the brightness.
Two little red beads suddenly appear in the corner of the video, directly facing the camera. They begin to draw closer.
*Rustling sounds*
Squeak, squeak!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hold up, what is that...?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: A musbeast?!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: It's a freakin' chonker!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Where? Lemme see.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Over there! Look!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Wait, why's there one over here too?!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Ah! It, it jumped on Robbie's face and bit the heck out of him! After that... Robbie dropped the video camera, and it jumped out the window!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Let me see!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Wait a damned second, there's another one over here! Why are there so many of 'em?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Wait, don't tell me, the abandoned factory... is nothing more than a musbeast den?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: No way! So much stuff was going on in there. There was that knocking sound, even though nobody was at the door, and then it opened on its own!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Then, Robbie's video camera started looping! Also, I couldn't get up to the second floor, no matter how hard I tried, and time stopped! No matter which way I took, the time was stuck at 12:15 and I kept going around in circles on the first floor!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: L-Let me see for myself!
Click drags the loading bar aside.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Also, I lost contact with you!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: And here!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Our comms went down because... a musbeast tinkled on the base station and caused it to short circuit?!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Then... Then, why was I stuck on the first floor?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: And here!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: They chewed through the stairs because they were nesting there?!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: And the time got stuck at 12:15 because they ruined my watch?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Musbeast
steps.text: Squeak, squeak!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: You little runt, I see you now! Hahaha! I swear upon my honor I will slay you this day––

steps.name: Musbeast
steps.text: (Darts away hurriedly)

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: GET–– BACK–– HERE––!!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Captain, does this mean... there isn't actually any paranormal stuff going on? It was all the fault of a chonky musbeast?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: All of it?!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Huh... so it was just a musbeast after all...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: B-But, if we come out with the truth in our video, it won't make for good content...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: We've already made our trailer, and everyone's expecting some horror factory adventure story, either to get a fright themselves or to watch our reactions. But a musbeast? That's just so boring.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What should we do then?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Let's stick to the original plan. It's a horror video, plain and simple. We'll cut the part where the musbeast shows up.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Just like all the junk you blurred out. People want a bit of drama in their videos, and nobody's gonna be interested if it's too ordinary and realistic.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: See what people are talking about on our trailer page? We can't go wrong giving them what they want to see!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: You don't like the sound of that?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Good grief, Click! Why are you acting like a novice who's never touched a video camera before? Do you think we're misleading our audience or something? C'mere, listen up. This has nothing to do with deceiving anyone...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: That's not what I meant!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I totally agree with you!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I think you made a very good point! That's something everyone can sink their teeth into.

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Sink... their teeth into... me?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: You think I'm gonna let you eat me? Ol' Robbie here's gonna knock the daylight outta you––

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Calm down, Robbie! That's just a rock––

steps.name: Click
steps.text: How's it looking, Cap'n? Anything that needs editing?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Nothing else? Are we good then?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Robbie? Are you feeling better yet? I'm about to upload the video. In three, two, one!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: C'mon, c'mon! Refresh, refresh! I wanna see the comments!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: The views are starting to shoot up! What are people saying?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I don't see anything in the comments section yet, they're probably still watching. But, the number of likes is going up quickly. We're about to break a thousand already!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: The featured video at the top of the charts has 30,000 views, and we've already reached 5,000... No, 8,000!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: The comments are starting to roll in! 'I started screaming along with that guy!' 'Nopenopenope, don't wanna watch! Someone tell me what's behind the door?' 'Every time the camera perspective changes, my heart skips a beat!'

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Whew, my friends are starting to DM me. Looks like they're envious!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Wait, what? We've already reached 10,000 views?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: C'mooooon, reach 30,000! Pleaaaase! I wanna top the charts at least one time!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: One sec. I'm gonna refresh real quick. There might be a little delay.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hmm, it seems like...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Engagements are starting to slow down... 25,000. Let's wait and see what happens?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Mmhmm!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hey, Cap'n, second place is already really impressive! Plus, we just uploaded the video. Who knows, we might take the top spot in the evening!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Look at the video at the top of the charts. It's just a guy walking along, munching on street food with a smile on his face. He's not even saying anything other than 'It's so delicious, you've gotta come down to try it!' We can top this for sure.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: You stole the words right outta my mouth, girl.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: But, I should be the one consoling you, not the other way around. You should feel proud that you pulled this off on your very first shoot.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Teehee.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: C'mon, we've been working hard all day and night, so I'll go grab food? We've been so busy I'm practically starving here.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Pizza or honey biscuits? Or maybe you're in the mood for some cured meat?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Gimme beer! Lots of beer!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Hahaha! I'm gonna barbecue this whole factory!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Huh? Is he still not back to normal?
Two days later...

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Ugh, it's been two whole days, and we're still stuck at second. Why... can't we get more than a few hundred views? Are we seriously going to lose to some random shopping and eating video?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: If we don't get enough money this time, we're gonna be tight on food budget for next month, and it'll also push Click's startup fund back a few more months.

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: And... what's that burning smell?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: *cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Urgh! Where's all this smoke coming from? What's going on with our equipment?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Click? Robbie?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: It's fine! It's fine! There's way too many comments on the video, so it's having a hard time loading!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Too many comments? Didn't our video get stuck in second place?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Wait, wait. What's going on? There's a new video at the top of the list now? 'Truth Demystified: The Supernatural Abandoned Factory'?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: This video is of the same place we went to... Wait, no, this is our footage! I can hear Robbie's voice! And... it's all the clips with the musbeast!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Click?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Teehee.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Wanna guess who made this new video?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Take a look! It's driving the view count on our adventure video up! After watching the myth-busting video, people are re-watching the full version and everyone's trying to find the musbeast in the comments in real time!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: Huh? Our video just hit the top of the list?

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: And the Demystified video is in second place!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Smugly shakes the terminal that is giving off smoke, overloaded by the maxed out comments section)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Now let's see where that shopping video is in comparison!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: My goodness, Click!
As the wispy black smoke curls around the room, Robbie lets out two powerful sneezes.
As if waking up from a dream, he lets go of the folding chair he was trying to pummel just a moment ago, and sees that the video he starred in has reached over 50,000 views.

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Huh? Wooooah! We're number one? We're number one?!

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Click! Am I dreaming?! Or did I die in the factory?

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Where am I? Is this Columbia or Bolívar?
The teammates squeeze in front of the terminal, watching the adventure video compete for the top spot with the myth-busting video, their view counts continuing to skyrocket.
A notification pops up from the background and the revenue figures from the two videos start to roll in as well, causing more black smoke to leak from the terminal.

steps.name: Lighting Engineer
steps.text: Yaaaaay!!

steps.name: Camera Crew Leader
steps.text: We're eatin' good–!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: My startup fund!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: My video studio... is finally about to open!
